senses.definition: (computing) A desktop computer, normally more powerful than a normal PC and often dedicated to a specific task, such as graphics.

quotes.text: All train movements on the Far North Line have been controlled by a Radio Electronic Token Block workstation at Inverness since 1995, having already been introduced on the Kyle Line some 11 years earlier.
quotes.reference: 2021 October 20, Paul Stephen, “Leisure and pleasure on the Far North Line: Radio Electronic Token Block”, in RAIL, number 942, page 48:

senses.definition: An area, at a workplace, for a single worker.

quotes.text: Lamb ignored her, surveying her team instead, who were at their own or each other's workstations, and engrossed in their current tasks, and studying every move he made.
